creator: Volleyball Game Group
redeem: Launch Volleyball Legends on Roblox and wait until you load into the lobby.
Click the Shop button at the bottom of the screen.
In the shop, pick the Codes tab from the menu on the left side.
Type or paste a code into the Type code here box, keeping the underscores and capital letters.
Press Use Code and your spins are added right away.
notes:
Volleyball Legends is a fast team volleyball game on Roblox, inspired by anime sports shows and first released as Haikyuu Legends in late 2024. You join a pickup match or a ranked game with up to six players per side, then bump, set, spike, block, and dive to keep the ball off your floor. Every player equips a style and an ability that change things like jump height, spike power, and speed.

Codes give Lucky Style Spins and Lucky Ability Spins, and sometimes an XP boost. Lucky Style Spins are the ones to save for, because your style shapes almost everything your player can do and lucky spins raise your odds of a rare one. New codes usually come with the weekly Saturday update and are named after the update number, like UPDATE_89, so check back each weekend.

faq.q: Why does a Volleyball Legends code say invalid?
faq.a: Codes here use capital letters and underscores, so UPDATE_89 will not work as update89. Most codes only last about a week before the next update replaces them, so an older code has probably expired.

faq.q: Should I use Lucky Style Spins or Lucky Ability Spins first?
faq.a: Most players spend Lucky Style Spins first, since your style sets your core stats. Ability spins matter more once you have a style you plan to keep.

faq.q: When do new Volleyball Legends codes come out?
faq.a: The game updates every Saturday, and a new code named after the update number usually arrives with it. Event codes, like the Halloween themed ones, show up during seasonal events.

tips: To serve, click once, then click again to choose power. You can jump and spike the serve, or let the ball drop to bump it in safely.
Tilt while spiking to change where the ball goes. Aiming away from the other team's players makes your spikes much harder to return.
Press Ctrl on PC or X on console to dive. Diving saves balls that would otherwise hit your side of the floor.
Use pickup games to get used to your style and controls. Move to ranked once your serves and spikes feel natural.
useRewards: UPDATE_89 and WE_CURSED give 10 Lucky Style Spins together, and SKELETON adds 5 Lucky Ability Spins. Codes rotate out with each Saturday update, so redeem all three soon. When you land a new style, try it in a pickup match before you reroll, so you do not throw away one that suits you. XP boost codes are best saved for long sessions.
